command:
L=.claude/scripts/lib/dec-write-lib.sh; S=grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-259/reviewer-afix.md#decision-bullets
bash $L new --cycle cycle-130 --status proposed --phase implementation --category security --recorded-by lead-seed --source "$S (Y-2)" --summary "The grading container is named, init-wrapped and limited (pids 256, 2g, 2 cpus, cap-drop ALL, no-new-privileges) with a kill deadline and docker kill/rm -f (Y-2)" --decision "exec_in_tree runs timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=10 <T> inside docker run --rm --init --name ablgrade-<run>-<label>-<pid>-<n> --pids-limit 256 --memory 2g --cpus 2 --cap-drop ALL --security-opt no-new-privileges; the client deadline is T + 10 + max(5, min(60, T/2)); on expiry the process group is killed and docker kill then rm -f run by name; stdout is capped at 4 MiB keeping the first and last 2 MiB (output_truncated); LOA_EVAL_GRADE_TIMEOUT_S overrides T for tests." --rationale "a test that ignores SIGTERM lived on and a killed docker client left the container writing into the tree later steps trust (MEDIUM-A1); pipeline-run.sh already runs phases this way" --alternative-json '{"option":"rely on timeout alone","rejected_because":"timeout without --kill-after waits forever on a SIGTERM-ignoring process and the docker client kill does not stop the container"}' 2>&1 | tail -1 | cut -c1-60
bash $L new --cycle cycle-130 --status proposed --phase implementation --category security --recorded-by lead-seed --source "$S (Y-3)" --summary "Every agent byte the host grader reads is bounded (O_NOFOLLOW, 1 MiB node files, 16 MiB copies, 2 MiB readers); host mode is opt-in; no credential store exempt (Y-3)" --decision "node_text reads the grader-owned copy first and otherwise requires safe_rel + is_within and read_regular (O_RDONLY|O_NOFOLLOW|O_NONBLOCK, S_ISREG, 1 MiB); copy_tree and the snapshot tar filter skip regular files above 16 MiB (oversized_files_skipped); churn, gate_verdict, review_md_verdict, combined_findings and envelope_texts read at most 2 MiB and refuse symlinks; --executor host is refused unless LOA_EVAL_ALLOW_HOST_GRADING=1; the contamination allowlist no longer exempts ~/.aws ~/.codex ~/.claude.json ~/.claude, treats ~/ $HOME/ ${HOME}/ as outside and flags /proc/*/environ|cmdline|maps|mem and /var/run." --rationale "stdout-printed node ids, sparse files and symlinks were host-side hazards (MEDIUM-A2, MEDIUM-A3); the CLI's own config reads never appear as tool_use events, so exempting credential stores only shielded the agent (LOW-A2)" --alternative-json '{"option":"derive test ids only from grader-owned copies and never open tree files","rejected_because":"an agent may legitimately add tests; the bounded, validated read keeps their ordering while removing the hazard"}' 2>&1 | tail -1 | cut -c1-60
echo "rows: $(grep -c '^  - id: "DEC-' grimoires/loa/decisions.yaml)"; cd grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-259 && mv auditor-sprint-feedback.md auditor-sprint-feedback-r1.md && ls | tr '\n' ' '
